result.title: Continual-ARC: Measuring Skill Acquisition over a Working Lifetime
result.comment: 54 pages, 14 figures. Code and run records: https://github.com/unifyai/continual-arc
result.summary: Agent harnesses have emerged as a promising mechanism for continual learning, alongside test-time parametric learning. However, the current benchmarks have several limitations: they generally focus on a single applied domain, serve each instance only once, and assume a single family of learner, so memory-based and weight-based systems are rarely compared on the same scale. We propose Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream built from the three ARC-AGI editions, whose tasks need no domain knowledge. The same tasks return after dormant gaps with fresh instances, while new tasks keep arriving. On each instance, the learner may pay for demonstrations, submit answers, or act inside the harness, with retries permitted on incorrect submissions, which are paid for. Each instance is scored based on the share of this feedback budget consumed. Since a learner may keep anything between instances, memory-based and weight-based systems are scored on the same scale. After the stream, the learner is frozen and tested on fresh instances of the tasks it met, which measures memorization, and on unseen tasks, which measures generalization. We run an agent harness with frozen weights, with and without persistence, on Qwen3.5-9B and GLM-5.3 Flash, comparing them with two prompting floors, a program-induction method and Qwen3.5-9B's weights trained to imitate GLM-5.3 Flash. Persistence in the harness generally does not improve memorization unless provided with explicit expert guidance. Most harness-based methods still learn less than a floor that simply caches each task's demonstrations, across all models we tested. Harness-based methods gain little or nothing on unseen tasks, whereas weight-based learning shows substantial gains. This opens the door to future weight-based continual learning that could teach models to drive harnesses in new domains.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Continual-ARC 终身学习基准：以三个 ARC-AGI 版本构造任务流，旧任务在休眠间隔后以新实例重现并持续加入新任务；学习者可付费获取示范、提交答案或在 harness 内操作，按反馈预算消耗计分，并据此在同一尺度上比较记忆型与权重型方法及 harness 持久化的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「跨实例可保留什么」与「按证据获取和重试成本计分、流结束后冻结测记忆与泛化」的评测设计，可能为 LVR 的状态保留、证据筛选与停止决策评价提供参照；但核心是持续学习而非 latent 视觉推理，可迁移性需核查。
